--!strict
-- Tetromino shapes, their four SRS rotation states and the SRS wall-kick tables. Pure data: no engine calls.

-- A block of a piece inside its bounding box: X to the right, Y downwards from the box's top row.
export type Offset = { X: number, Y: number }

export type Shape = {
	Name: string,
	-- The bounding box's width and height.
	Size: number,
	-- States[state + 1] holds the four blocks of rotation state 0 (spawn), 1 (R), 2 or 3 (L).
	States: { { Offset } },
	-- The board column of the box's left edge when the piece spawns.
	SpawnLeft: number,
}

-- A kick: the column shift and the row shift (up-positive) tried for one rotation.
export type Kick = { number }

local Pieces = {}

Pieces.Names = table.freeze({ "I", "O", "T", "S", "Z", "J", "L" })

local function rotateClockwise(blocks: { Offset }, size: number): { Offset }
	local out: { Offset } = {}
	for i, block in blocks do
		out[i] = { X = size - 1 - block.Y, Y = block.X }
	end
	return out
end

local function makeShape(name: string, size: number, spawnLeft: number, blocks: { { number } }): Shape
	local first: { Offset } = {}
	for i, block in blocks do
		first[i] = { X = block[1], Y = block[2] }
	end
	local states: { { Offset } } = { first }
	for state = 2, 4 do
		states[state] = rotateClockwise(states[state - 1], size)
	end
	return { Name = name, Size = size, States = states, SpawnLeft = spawnLeft }
end

local shapes: { [string]: Shape } = {
	I = makeShape("I", 4, 4, { { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 }, { 2, 1 }, { 3, 1 } }),
	O = makeShape("O", 2, 5, { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 } }),
	T = makeShape("T", 3, 4, { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 }, { 2, 1 } }),
	S = makeShape("S", 3, 4, { { 1, 0 }, { 2, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 } }),
	Z = makeShape("Z", 3, 4, { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 1, 1 }, { 2, 1 } }),
	J = makeShape("J", 3, 4, { { 0, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 }, { 2, 1 } }),
	L = makeShape("L", 3, 4, { { 2, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 }, { 2, 1 } }),
}

-- SRS kicks of the J, L, S, T and Z pieces, by "<from>><to>" rotation state.
local jlstzKicks: { [string]: { Kick } } = {
	["0>1"] = { { 0, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { -1, 1 }, { 0, -2 }, { -1, -2 } },
	["1>0"] = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 1, -1 }, { 0, 2 }, { 1, 2 } },
	["1>2"] = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 1, -1 }, { 0, 2 }, { 1, 2 } },
	["2>1"] = { { 0, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { -1, 1 }, { 0, -2 }, { -1, -2 } },
	["2>3"] = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 1, 1 }, { 0, -2 }, { 1, -2 } },
	["3>2"] = { { 0, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { -1, -1 }, { 0, 2 }, { -1, 2 } },
	["3>0"] = { { 0, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { -1, -1 }, { 0, 2 }, { -1, 2 } },
	["0>3"] = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 1, 1 }, { 0, -2 }, { 1, -2 } },
}

-- SRS kicks of the I piece.
local iKicks: { [string]: { Kick } } = {
	["0>1"] = { { 0, 0 }, { -2, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { -2, -1 }, { 1, 2 } },
	["1>0"] = { { 0, 0 }, { 2, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 2, 1 }, { -1, -2 } },
	["1>2"] = { { 0, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 2, 0 }, { -1, 2 }, { 2, -1 } },
	["2>1"] = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { -2, 0 }, { 1, -2 }, { -2, 1 } },
	["2>3"] = { { 0, 0 }, { 2, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 2, 1 }, { -1, -2 } },
	["3>2"] = { { 0, 0 }, { -2, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { -2, -1 }, { 1, 2 } },
	["3>0"] = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { -2, 0 }, { 1, -2 }, { -2, 1 } },
	["0>3"] = { { 0, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 2, 0 }, { -1, 2 }, { 2, -1 } },
}

local noKicks: { Kick } = { { 0, 0 } }

-- The shape of a piece by its name ("I", "O", "T", "S", "Z", "J" or "L").
function Pieces.Get(name: string): Shape
	local shape = shapes[name]
	if shape == nil then
		error(`unknown piece '{name}'`)
	end
	return shape
end

-- The kicks tried, in order, when the piece rotates from one state (0 to 3) to another.
function Pieces.Kicks(name: string, from: number, to: number): { Kick }
	if name == "O" then
		return noKicks
	end
	local kicks = if name == "I" then iKicks else jlstzKicks
	return kicks[`{from}>{to}`] or noKicks
end

return Pieces

--!strict
-- The well: 10 columns by 22 rows, column 1 at the left and row 1 at the bottom. Rows 1 to 20 are visible;
-- rows 21 and 22 lie above the top, where pieces spawn. Pure logic: no engine calls.
local Pieces = require("./Pieces")

export type Board = {
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	Visible: number,
	-- Cells[(row - 1) * Width + column]: "" when empty, else the name of the piece that left the block there.
	Cells: { string },
	Get: (self: Board, column: number, row: number) -> string,
	IsFree: (self: Board, column: number, row: number) -> boolean,
	Fits: (self: Board, name: string, state: number, left: number, top: number) -> boolean,
	Place: (self: Board, name: string, state: number, left: number, top: number) -> boolean,
	ClearLines: (self: Board) -> number,
	SetRow: (self: Board, row: number, pattern: string) -> (),
	Clear: (self: Board) -> (),
	ToAscii: (self: Board) -> string,
}

local Width, Height, Visible = 10, 22, 20

local function get(self: Board, column: number, row: number): string
	return self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column]
end

-- Inside the well (above the top counts as inside) and empty.
local function isFree(self: Board, column: number, row: number): boolean
	if column < 1 or column > self.Width or row < 1 then
		return false
	end
	if row > self.Height then
		return true
	end
	return self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column] == ""
end

-- Whether the piece in that rotation state fits with its box's left column and top row there.
local function fits(self: Board, name: string, state: number, left: number, top: number): boolean
	for _, block in Pieces.Get(name).States[state + 1] do
		if not isFree(self, left + block.X, top - block.Y) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Writes the piece's blocks; returns true when every block lies above the visible rows (a lock out).
local function place(self: Board, name: string, state: number, left: number, top: number): boolean
	local above = true
	for _, block in Pieces.Get(name).States[state + 1] do
		local column, row = left + block.X, top - block.Y
		if row <= self.Visible then
			above = false
		end
		if row >= 1 and row <= self.Height and column >= 1 and column <= self.Width then
			self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column] = name
		end
	end
	return above
end

-- Removes every full row, moving the rows above it down; returns how many rows it removed.
local function clearLines(self: Board): number
	local width = self.Width
	local cells = self.Cells
	local target = 1
	local cleared = 0
	for row = 1, self.Height do
		local full = true
		for column = 1, width do
			if cells[(row - 1) * width + column] == "" then
				full = false
				break
			end
		end
		if full then
			cleared += 1
		else
			if target ~= row then
				for column = 1, width do
					cells[(target - 1) * width + column] = cells[(row - 1) * width + column]
				end
			end
			target += 1
		end
	end
	for row = target, self.Height do
		for column = 1, width do
			cells[(row - 1) * width + column] = ""
		end
	end
	return cleared
end

-- Fills one row from a pattern of Width characters: "." leaves a cell empty, any other character is a block.
local function setRow(self: Board, row: number, pattern: string)
	for column = 1, self.Width do
		local character = string.sub(pattern, column, column)
		self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column] = if character == "." or character == "" then "" else character
	end
end

local function clear(self: Board)
	for i = 1, self.Width * self.Height do
		self.Cells[i] = ""
	end
end

-- The visible rows, top first, one line per row: "." for an empty cell, else the block's piece name.
local function toAscii(self: Board): string
	local lines: { string } = {}
	for row = self.Visible, 1, -1 do
		local characters: { string } = {}
		for column = 1, self.Width do
			local cell = self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column]
			characters[column] = if cell == "" then "." else cell
		end
		table.insert(lines, table.concat(characters))
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local Board = {}

function Board.New(): Board
	local board: Board = {
		Width = Width,
		Height = Height,
		Visible = Visible,
		Cells = table.create(Width * Height, ""),
		Get = get,
		IsFree = isFree,
		Fits = fits,
		Place = place,
		ClearLines = clearLines,
		SetRow = setRow,
		Clear = clear,
		ToAscii = toAscii,
	}
	return board
end

return Board

--!strict
-- The 7-bag randomizer: every run of seven draws holds each piece once. It draws from a generator its caller
-- creates in a callback (Random is unavailable at a module's top level).
local Pieces = require("./Pieces")

export type Bag = {
	Generator: RandomGenerator,
	Pending: { string },
	Draw: (self: Bag) -> string,
	Reset: (self: Bag) -> (),
}

local function draw(self: Bag): string
	if #self.Pending == 0 then
		self.Pending = self.Generator:Shuffle(table.clone(Pieces.Names))
	end
	return table.remove(self.Pending, 1) :: string
end

-- Drops the rest of the current bag, so the next draw starts a fresh one.
local function reset(self: Bag)
	table.clear(self.Pending)
end

local Bag = {}

function Bag.New(generator: RandomGenerator): Bag
	local bag: Bag = { Generator = generator, Pending = {}, Draw = draw, Reset = reset }
	return bag
end

return Bag

--!strict
-- One game of Tetris as pure, tick-driven logic: spawning, SRS rotation, DAS/ARR shifting, gravity by level,
-- soft and hard drops, lock delay, hold, the next queue, line clears, scoring, levels and game over.
-- No engine calls: the Game behaviour feeds it Controls every tick and mirrors its state into the scene.
local Bag = require("./Bag")
local Board = require("./Board")
local Pieces = require("./Pieces")

-- The player's controls for one tick: held states and the presses of this tick.
export type Controls = {
	Left: boolean,
	Right: boolean,
	LeftPressed: boolean,
	RightPressed: boolean,
	SoftDrop: boolean,
	HardDrop: boolean,
	RotateCW: boolean,
	RotateCCW: boolean,
	Hold: boolean,
}

export type Match = {
	Board: Board.Board,
	Bag: Bag.Bag,
	-- The falling piece: its name, rotation state (0 to 3), box left column and box top row.
	Piece: string,
	State: number,
	Left: number,
	Top: number,
	Hold: string,
	HoldUsed: boolean,
	Queue: { string },
	Score: number,
	Lines: number,
	Level: number,
	GameOver: boolean,
	LockedCount: number,
	LastClear: number,
	LastClearPoints: number,
	GravityTimer: number,
	LockTimer: number,
	LockResets: number,
	LowestTop: number,
	ShiftDirection: number,
	ShiftTimer: number,
	-- What happened during the last Step, Reset or method call, in order (sounds and HUD read it).
	Events: { string },
	Step: (self: Match, controls: Controls) -> (),
	Move: (self: Match, columns: number) -> boolean,
	Rotate: (self: Match, direction: number) -> boolean,
	HardDrop: (self: Match) -> number,
	HoldPiece: (self: Match) -> boolean,
	SpawnPiece: (self: Match, name: string) -> boolean,
	DropDistance: (self: Match) -> number,
	GravityTicks: (self: Match) -> number,
	Reset: (self: Match) -> (),
}

local Match = {}

-- Ticks per row of gravity at 60 Hz, by level; levels past the end use the last entry.
Match.GravityByLevel = table.freeze({ 48, 43, 38, 33, 28, 23, 18, 13, 8, 6, 5, 5, 5, 4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1 })
-- Points per clear of 1, 2, 3 and 4 lines, multiplied by the level.
Match.LineScores = table.freeze({ 100, 300, 500, 800 })
Match.LinesPerLevel = 10
Match.SoftDropTicks = 2
Match.LockDelay = 30
Match.MaxLockResets = 15
Match.DasDelay = 10
Match.ArrTicks = 2
Match.PreviewCount = 3
Match.SpawnTop = 22

local function emit(self: Match, event: string)
	table.insert(self.Events, event)
end

local function fitsAt(self: Match, left: number, top: number): boolean
	return self.Board:Fits(self.Piece, self.State, left, top)
end

local function endGame(self: Match)
	if not self.GameOver then
		self.GameOver = true
		emit(self, "GameOver")
	end
end

-- After a successful move or rotation: a grounded piece gets its lock delay back, at most MaxLockResets times per row.
local function afterShift(self: Match)
	if not fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - 1) and self.LockResets < Match.MaxLockResets then
		self.LockTimer = 0
		self.LockResets += 1
	end
end

local function spawnPiece(self: Match, name: string): boolean
	local shape = Pieces.Get(name)
	self.Piece = name
	self.State = 0
	self.Left = shape.SpawnLeft
	self.Top = Match.SpawnTop
	self.GravityTimer = 0
	self.LockTimer = 0
	self.LockResets = 0
	if not fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top) then
		endGame(self)
		return false
	end
	-- Pieces spawn in rows 21 and 22 and drop one row at once when nothing blocks them.
	if fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - 1) then
		self.Top -= 1
	end
	self.LowestTop = self.Top
	return true
end

local function takeNext(self: Match): string
	local name = table.remove(self.Queue, 1) :: string
	table.insert(self.Queue, self.Bag:Draw())
	return name
end

local function spawnNext(self: Match)
	self.HoldUsed = false
	spawnPiece(self, takeNext(self))
end

local function lock(self: Match)
	local lockOut = self.Board:Place(self.Piece, self.State, self.Left, self.Top)
	self.LockedCount += 1
	emit(self, "Lock")
	local cleared = self.Board:ClearLines()
	if cleared > 0 then
		local points = Match.LineScores[cleared] * self.Level
		self.Score += points
		self.Lines += cleared
		self.LastClear = cleared
		self.LastClearPoints = points
		emit(self, `Clear{cleared}`)
		local level = 1 + self.Lines // Match.LinesPerLevel
		if level > self.Level then
			self.Level = level
			emit(self, "LevelUp")
		end
	end
	if lockOut then
		endGame(self)
		return
	end
	spawnNext(self)
end

local function move(self: Match, columns: number): boolean
	if self.GameOver or not fitsAt(self, self.Left + columns, self.Top) then
		return false
	end
	self.Left += columns
	emit(self, "Move")
	afterShift(self)
	return true
end

-- Rotates clockwise (1) or counter-clockwise (-1), trying each SRS kick in order.
local function rotate(self: Match, direction: number): boolean
	if self.GameOver or self.Piece == "O" then
		return false
	end
	local from = self.State
	local to = (from + direction) % 4
	for _, kick in Pieces.Kicks(self.Piece, from, to) do
		local left, top = self.Left + kick[1], self.Top + kick[2]
		if self.Board:Fits(self.Piece, to, left, top) then
			self.State = to
			self.Left = left
			self.Top = top
			emit(self, "Rotate")
			afterShift(self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function dropDistance(self: Match): number
	local distance = 0
	while fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - distance - 1) do
		distance += 1
	end
	return distance
end

-- Drops the piece to the floor and locks it there; returns the rows it fell.
local function hardDrop(self: Match): number
	if self.GameOver then
		return 0
	end
	local distance = dropDistance(self)
	self.Top -= distance
	emit(self, "HardDrop")
	lock(self)
	return distance
end

-- Swaps the falling piece with the held one (or the next one when nothing is held), once per piece.
local function holdPiece(self: Match): boolean
	if self.GameOver or self.HoldUsed then
		return false
	end
	local current = self.Piece
	local incoming = if self.Hold == "" then takeNext(self) else self.Hold
	self.Hold = current
	emit(self, "Hold")
	spawnPiece(self, incoming)
	self.HoldUsed = true
	return true
end

local function gravityTicks(self: Match): number
	local table_ = Match.GravityByLevel
	return table_[math.min(self.Level, #table_)]
end

local function shift(self: Match, controls: Controls)
	if controls.LeftPressed then
		self.ShiftDirection = -1
		self.ShiftTimer = 0
		move(self, -1)
		return
	elseif controls.RightPressed then
		self.ShiftDirection = 1
		self.ShiftTimer = 0
		move(self, 1)
		return
	end
	local held = (self.ShiftDirection == -1 and controls.Left) or (self.ShiftDirection == 1 and controls.Right)
	if not held then
		self.ShiftDirection = if controls.Left then -1 elseif controls.Right then 1 else 0
		self.ShiftTimer = 0
		return
	end
	self.ShiftTimer += 1
	if self.ShiftTimer >= Match.DasDelay and (self.ShiftTimer - Match.DasDelay) % Match.ArrTicks == 0 then
		move(self, self.ShiftDirection)
	end
end

local function step(self: Match, controls: Controls)
	table.clear(self.Events)
	if self.GameOver then
		return
	end
	if controls.Hold then
		holdPiece(self)
		if self.GameOver then
			return
		end
	end
	if controls.RotateCW then
		rotate(self, 1)
	end
	if controls.RotateCCW then
		rotate(self, -1)
	end
	shift(self, controls)
	if controls.HardDrop then
		hardDrop(self)
		return
	end

	local interval = gravityTicks(self)
	if controls.SoftDrop then
		interval = math.min(interval, Match.SoftDropTicks)
	end
	self.GravityTimer += 1
	if self.GravityTimer >= interval then
		self.GravityTimer = 0
		if fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - 1) then
			self.Top -= 1
			if self.Top < self.LowestTop then
				self.LowestTop = self.Top
				self.LockResets = 0
			end
			self.LockTimer = 0
		end
	end

	if fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - 1) then
		self.LockTimer = 0
	else
		self.LockTimer += 1
		if self.LockTimer >= Match.LockDelay then
			lock(self)
		end
	end
end

-- Starts a fresh game on the same generator: an empty well, a new bag and the score, lines and level reset.
local function reset(self: Match)
	table.clear(self.Events)
	self.Board:Clear()
	self.Bag:Reset()
	table.clear(self.Queue)
	for _ = 1, Match.PreviewCount do
		table.insert(self.Queue, self.Bag:Draw())
	end
	self.Hold = ""
	self.Score = 0
	self.Lines = 0
	self.Level = 1
	self.GameOver = false
	self.LockedCount = 0
	self.LastClear = 0
	self.LastClearPoints = 0
	self.ShiftDirection = 0
	self.ShiftTimer = 0
	emit(self, "Restart")
	spawnNext(self)
end

function Match.New(generator: RandomGenerator): Match
	local match: Match = {
		Board = Board.New(),
		Bag = Bag.New(generator),
		Piece = "",
		State = 0,
		Left = 0,
		Top = 0,
		Hold = "",
		HoldUsed = false,
		Queue = {},
		Score = 0,
		Lines = 0,
		Level = 1,
		GameOver = false,
		LockedCount = 0,
		LastClear = 0,
		LastClearPoints = 0,
		GravityTimer = 0,
		LockTimer = 0,
		LockResets = 0,
		LowestTop = 0,
		ShiftDirection = 0,
		ShiftTimer = 0,
		Events = {},
		Step = step,
		Move = move,
		Rotate = rotate,
		HardDrop = hardDrop,
		HoldPiece = holdPiece,
		SpawnPiece = spawnPiece,
		DropDistance = dropDistance,
		GravityTicks = gravityTicks,
		Reset = reset,
	}
	reset(match)
	table.clear(match.Events)
	return match
end

-- Controls with nothing held or pressed, for callers that fill them in each tick.
function Match.NewControls(): Controls
	return {
		Left = false,

--!strict

local Match = require("./Match")
local Pieces = require("./Pieces")

export type Game = ScriptInstance & {
	CellPrefab: AssetRef?,
	Materials: { AssetRef? },
	MoveSound: AssetRef?,
	RotateSound: AssetRef?,
	LockSound: AssetRef?,
	DropSound: AssetRef?,
	ClearSound: AssetRef?,
	TetrisSound: AssetRef?,
	HoldSound: AssetRef?,
	LevelSound: AssetRef?,
	GameOverSound: AssetRef?,
	Match: Match.Match,
	Controls: Match.Controls,
	Cells: { Entity },
	Display: { string },
	ShownName: { string },
	ShownMaterial: { string },
	Previews: { Entity },
	PreviewName: { string },
	Texts: { [string]: Entity },
	TextShown: { [string]: string },
	HudScore: number,
	HudLevel: number,
	HudLines: number,
	ClearTimer: number,
}

local Game = {}

Game.Fields = {
	CellPrefab = Field.Asset("Prefab"),
	-- The materials of the I, O, T, S, Z, J and L blocks, then of the ghost piece and of any other block.
	Materials = Field.Array(Field.Asset("Material")),
	MoveSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	RotateSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	LockSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	DropSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	ClearSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	TetrisSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	HoldSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	LevelSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	GameOverSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
}

local Columns, Rows = 10, 20
local CellScale = 0.94
local PreviewScale = 0.75
-- World centres (x, y) of the preview slots: the hold, then the three next pieces.
local PreviewSlots = { { -7.5, 7.5 }, { 7.5, 7.5 }, { 7.5, 4.5 }, { 7.5, 1.5 } }
local MaterialIndex: { [string]: number } = { I = 1, O = 2, T = 3, S = 4, Z = 5, J = 6, L = 7, Ghost = 8 }
local OtherMaterial = 9
local ClearNames = { "SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "TETRIS!" }
local ClearShowTicks = 120
local HudTexts = { "ScoreText", "LevelText", "LinesText", "ClearText", "StatusText" }
local GameOverMessage = "GAME OVER\nPress Enter to restart"

local function cellPosition(column: number, row: number): vector
	return vector.create(column - 5.5, row - 10.5, 0)
end

local function materialFor(self: Game, name: string): AssetRef?
	return self.Materials[MaterialIndex[name] or OtherMaterial]
end

local function play(clip: AssetRef?)
	if clip then
		Audio.PlayOneShot(clip)
	end
end

local function setText(self: Game, key: string, value: string)
	if self.TextShown[key] == value then
		return
	end
	local entity = self.Texts[key]
	local text = if entity then entity.Text else nil
	if text then
		text.Text = value
		self.TextShown[key] = value
	end
end

local function onEvent(self: Game, event: string)
	local match = self.Match
	if event == "Move" then
		play(self.MoveSound)
	elseif event == "Rotate" then
		play(self.RotateSound)
	elseif event == "HardDrop" then
		play(self.DropSound)
	elseif event == "Lock" then
		if table.find(match.Events, "HardDrop") == nil then
			play(self.LockSound)
		end
	elseif event == "Hold" then
		play(self.HoldSound)
	elseif event == "LevelUp" then
		play(self.LevelSound)
	elseif event == "GameOver" then
		play(self.GameOverSound)
	elseif event == "Restart" then
		self.ClearTimer = 0
		setText(self, "ClearText", "")
	elseif string.sub(event, 1, 5) == "Clear" then
		local lines = math.clamp(tonumber(string.sub(event, 6)) or 1, 1, 4)
		play(if lines == 4 then self.TetrisSound else self.ClearSound)
		setText(self, "ClearText", `{ClearNames[lines]}\n+{match.LastClearPoints}`)
		self.ClearTimer = ClearShowTicks
	end

local function refreshWell(self: Game)
	local match = self.Match
	local display = self.Display
	local board = match.Board.Cells
	for i = 1, Columns * Rows do
		display[i] = board[i]
	end
	if not match.GameOver and match.Piece ~= "" then
		local blocks = Pieces.Get(match.Piece).States[match.State + 1]
		local ghostTop = match.Top - match:DropDistance()
		for _, block in blocks do
			local column, row = match.Left + block.X, ghostTop - block.Y
			if row >= 1 and row <= Rows and display[(row - 1) * Columns + column] == "" then
				display[(row - 1) * Columns + column] = "Ghost"
			end
		end
		for _, block in blocks do
			local column, row = match.Left + block.X, match.Top - block.Y
			if row >= 1 and row <= Rows then
				display[(row - 1) * Columns + column] = match.Piece
			end
		end
	end
	for i = 1, Columns * Rows do
		local name = display[i]
		if name ~= self.ShownName[i] then
			local cell = self.Cells[i]
			if name == "" then
				cell:SetActive(false)
			else
				if name ~= self.ShownMaterial[i] then
					local renderer = cell.MeshRenderer
					if renderer then
						renderer:SetMaterial(1, materialFor(self, name))
					end
					self.ShownMaterial[i] = name
				end
				cell:SetActive(true)
			end
			self.ShownName[i] = name
		end
	end
end

		end
		return
	end

	local minX, maxX, minY, maxY = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, block in blocks do
		minX, maxX = math.min(minX, block.X), math.max(maxX, block.X)
		minY, maxY = math.min(minY, block.Y), math.max(maxY, block.Y)
	end
	local centreX, centreY = (minX + maxX) / 2, (minY + maxY) / 2
	local slotX, slotY = PreviewSlots[slot][1], PreviewSlots[slot][2]
	local material = materialFor(self, name)
	for i, block in blocks do
		local cell = self.Previews[base + i]
		cell.Transform:Teleport(vector.create(slotX + (block.X - centreX) * PreviewScale, slotY - (block.Y - centreY) * PreviewScale, 0))
		local renderer = cell.MeshRenderer
		if renderer then
			renderer:SetMaterial(1, material)
		end
		cell:SetActive(true)
	end
end

local function refreshHud(self: Game)
	local match = self.Match
	if match.Score ~= self.HudScore then
		self.HudScore = match.Score
		setText(self, "ScoreText", `SCORE\n{match.Score}`)
	end
	if match.Level ~= self.HudLevel then
		self.HudLevel = match.Level
		setText(self, "LevelText", `LEVEL\n{match.Level}`)
	end
	if match.Lines ~= self.HudLines then
		self.HudLines = match.Lines
		setText(self, "LinesText", `LINES\n{match.Lines}`)
	end
	setText(self, "StatusText", if match.GameOver then GameOverMessage else "")
end

local function refresh(self: Game)
	refreshWell(self)
	local match = self.Match
	showPreview(self, 1, match.Hold)
	for i = 1, #PreviewSlots - 1 do
		showPreview(self, i + 1, match.Queue[i] or "")
	end
	refreshHud(self)
end

function Game.OnStart(self: Game)
	self.Match = Match.New(Random.New(Random.Integer(0, 2147483647)))
	self.Controls = Match.NewControls()
	self.Cells = {}
	self.Display = table.create(Columns * Rows, "")
	self.ShownName = table.create(Columns * Rows, "")
	self.ShownMaterial = table.create(Columns * Rows, "")
	self.Previews = {}
	self.PreviewName = {}
	self.Texts = {}
	self.TextShown = {}
	self.HudScore = -1
	self.HudLevel = -1
	self.HudLines = -1
	self.ClearTimer = 0

	for _, key in HudTexts do
		local found = Scene.FindByName(key)
		if found then
			self.Texts[key] = found
			local text = found.Text
			self.TextShown[key] = if text then text.Text else ""
		end
	end

	local prefab = self.CellPrefab
	if prefab == nil then
		Log.Error("Game: CellPrefab is not set")
		return
	end
	local cellsParent = self.Entity:FindChild("Cells") or self.Entity
	for row = 1, Rows do
		for column = 1, Columns do
			local cell = Scene.Instantiate(prefab, cellPosition(column, row), nil, cellsParent)
			cell.Name = string.format("Cell%02d_%02d", row, column)
			cell:SetActive(false)
			table.insert(self.Cells, cell)
		end
	end
	local previewParent = self.Entity:FindChild("Previews") or self.Entity
	for slot, centre in PreviewSlots do
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local cell = Scene.Instantiate(prefab, vector.create(centre[1], centre[2], 0), nil, previewParent)
			cell.Name = string.format("Preview%d_%d", slot, i)
			cell.Transform.Scale = vector.create(CellScale * PreviewScale, CellScale * PreviewScale, CellScale * PreviewScale)
			cell:SetActive(false)
			table.insert(self.Previews, cell)
		end
		self.PreviewName[slot] = ""
	end
	refresh(self)
end

function Game.OnFixedUpdate(self: Game, _dt: number)
	if #self.Cells == 0 then
		return
	end
	local match = self.Match
	if Input.IsActionPressed("Restart") then
		match:Reset()
	else
		local controls = self.Controls
		controls.Left = Input.IsActionDown("MoveLeft")
		controls.Right = Input.IsActionDown("MoveRight")
		controls.LeftPressed = Input.IsActionPressed("MoveLeft")
		controls.RightPressed = Input.IsActionPressed("MoveRight")
		controls.SoftDrop = Input.IsActionDown("SoftDrop")
		controls.HardDrop = Input.IsActionPressed("HardDrop")
		controls.RotateCW = Input.IsActionPressed("RotateCW")
		controls.RotateCCW = Input.IsActionPressed("RotateCCW")
		controls.Hold = Input.IsActionPressed("Hold")
		match:Step(controls)
	end
	for _, event in match.Events do
		onEvent(self, event)
	end
	if self.ClearTimer > 0 then
		self.ClearTimer -= 1
		if self.ClearTimer == 0 then
			setText(self, "ClearText", "")
		end
	end
	refresh(self)
end

return Script.Define("Game", Game)

function Game.OnFixedUpdate(self: Game, _dt: number)
	if #self.Cells == 0 then

		controls.Right = Input.IsActionDown("MoveRight")
		controls.LeftPressed = Input.IsActionPressed("MoveLeft")
		controls.RightPressed = Input.IsActionPressed("MoveRight")
		controls.SoftDrop = Input.IsActionDown("SoftDrop")
		controls.HardDrop = Input.IsActionPressed("HardDrop")
		controls.RotateCW = Input.IsActionPressed("RotateCW")
		controls.RotateCCW = Input.IsActionPressed("RotateCCW")
		controls.Hold = Input.IsActionPressed("Hold")
		match:Step(controls)
	end
	for _, event in match.Events do
		onEvent(self, event)
	end
	if self.ClearTimer > 0 then
		self.ClearTimer -= 1
		if self.ClearTimer == 0 then

		end
	end
	refresh(self)
end

--!strict
-- Integration cases in Main.scene, driven through the project's input actions with Test.InjectAction.
-- Each case starts from a fresh scene (Isolation "Case"); a few set up the board through the match first.
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")

local function getGame(): GameScript.Game
	local found = Scene.FindByName("Game")
	if found == nil then
		Test.Fail("Main.scene has no Game entity")
	end
	return (found :: Entity):GetScript() :: GameScript.Game
end

local function tap(action: string, waitTicks: number?)
	Test.InjectAction(action, "Tap")
	Test.WaitTicks(waitTicks or 2)
end

local function textOf(name: string): string
	local found = Scene.FindByName(name)
	local text = if found then found.Text else nil
	return if text then text.Text else "<missing>"
end

-- Counts the visible cells of the well that show a block of a piece (not the ghost).
local function countShown(game: GameScript.Game, row: number): number
	local count = 0
	for column = 1, 10 do
		local name = game.ShownName[(row - 1) * 10 + column]
		if name ~= "" and name ~= "Ghost" then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

return Test.Suite("Tetris", function()
	Test.Case("the scene pools the well, the previews and the HUD", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		Test.ExpectEqual(#game.Cells, 200, "one cell per visible square")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#game.Previews, 16, "four cells per preview slot")
		local active = 0
		for _, cell in game.Cells do
			if cell:IsActiveSelf() then
				active += 1
			end
		end
		Test.Expect(active >= 2 and active <= 8, `only the falling piece and its ghost show at the start (got {active})`)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ScoreText"), "SCORE\n0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LevelText"), "LEVEL\n1")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LinesText"), "LINES\n0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("StatusText"), "")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#game.Match.Queue, 3, "three next pieces")
		Test.Expect(game.Previews[5]:IsActiveSelf(), "the first next slot shows a piece")
		Test.Expect(not game.Previews[1]:IsActiveSelf(), "the hold slot starts empty")
	end)

	Test.Case("a hard drop locks the piece on the floor", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local piece = game.Match.Piece
		tap("HardDrop")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.LockedCount, 1, "one piece locked")
		Test.Expect(countShown(game, 1) >= 1, "blocks show in the bottom row")
		Test.Expect(game.Match.Piece ~= "", "the next piece spawned")
		local found = false
		for column = 1, 10 do
			if game.Match.Board:Get(column, 1) == piece then
				found = true
			end
		end
		Test.Expect(found, `the {piece} lies in row 1`)
	end)

	Test.Case("taps move one column and a held move auto-repeats to the wall", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local left = game.Match.Left
		tap("MoveLeft")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Left, left - 1, "a tap moves one column left")
		tap("MoveRight")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Left, left, "a tap moves one column right")
		Test.InjectAction("MoveRight", "Down")
		Test.WaitTicks(30)
		Test.InjectAction("MoveRight", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.Expect(not game.Match:Move(1), "DAS carried the piece to the right wall")
	end)

	Test.Case("rotate actions turn the piece both ways", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		if game.Match.Piece == "O" then
			tap("HardDrop")
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.State, 0)
		tap("RotateCW")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.State, 1, "clockwise")
		tap("RotateCW")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.State, 2, "clockwise again")
		tap("RotateCCW")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.State, 1, "counter-clockwise")
	end)

	Test.Case("hold stores the piece once per piece and shows it", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local first = game.Match.Piece
		local second = game.Match.Queue[1]
		tap("Hold")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Hold, first, "the piece went to the hold")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Piece, second, "the next piece came in")
		Test.Expect(game.Previews[1]:IsActiveSelf(), "the hold preview shows it")
		tap("Hold")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Piece, second, "a second hold of the same piece does nothing")
		tap("HardDrop")
		tap("Hold")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Piece, first, "the next piece swaps with the held one")
	end)

	Test.Case("soft drop falls faster than gravity", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local top = game.Match.Top
		Test.InjectAction("SoftDrop", "Down")
		Test.WaitTicks(12)
		Test.InjectAction("SoftDrop", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.Expect(game.Match.Top <= top - 5, `soft drop fell 5 rows or more (from {top} to {game.Match.Top})`)
	end)

	Test.Case("the ghost shows where the piece will land", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local ghosts = 0
		for i = 1, 20 do
			if game.ShownName[i] == "Ghost" then
				ghosts += 1
			end
		end
		Test.Expect(ghosts >= 1, "ghost cells show in the bottom rows")
		tap("MoveLeft")
		local moved = 0
		for i = 1, 20 do
			if game.ShownName[i] == "Ghost" then
				moved += 1
			end
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(moved, ghosts, "the ghost follows the piece")
	end)

	Test.Case("clearing a line scores and shows it on the HUD", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		game.Match.Board:SetRow(1, "XXXX..XXXX")
		game.Match:SpawnPiece("O")
		tap("HardDrop")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Lines, 1, "one line cleared")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Score, 100)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ScoreText"), "SCORE\n100")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LinesText"), "LINES\n1")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ClearText"), "SINGLE\n+100")
		Test.ExpectEqual(countShown(game, 1), 2, "the O's top half dropped into row 1")
		Test.WaitTicks(130)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ClearText"), "", "the clear banner fades")
	end)

	Test.Case("four lines with a vertical I score a tetris", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		for row = 1, 4 do
			game.Match.Board:SetRow(row, "XXXXXXXXX.")
		end
		game.Match:SpawnPiece("I")
		tap("RotateCW")
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			tap("MoveRight")
		end
		tap("HardDrop")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Lines, 4, "four lines cleared")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Score, 800)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ClearText"), "TETRIS!\n+800")
		Test.ExpectEqual(countShown(game, 1), 0, "the well is empty again")
	end)

	Test.Case("ten lines raise the level", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		game.Match.Lines = 9
		game.Match.Board:SetRow(1, "XXXX..XXXX")
		game.Match:SpawnPiece("O")
		tap("HardDrop")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Level, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LevelText"), "LEVEL\n2")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LinesText"), "LINES\n10")
	end)

	Test.Case("stacking hard drops tops out, then Restart starts a new game", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local drops = 0
		while not game.Match.GameOver and drops < 40 do
			tap("HardDrop", 3)
			drops += 1
		end
		Test.Expect(game.Match.GameOver, `the stack topped out after {drops} drops`)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("StatusText"), "GAME OVER\nPress Enter to restart")
		local locked = game.Match.LockedCount
		tap("HardDrop")
		tap("MoveLeft")
		Test.WaitTicks(120)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.LockedCount, locked, "the game waits after game over")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#Test.GetScriptErrors(), 0, "no script error at top-out")
		tap("Restart")
		Test.Expect(not game.Match.GameOver, "a new game started")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Score, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.LockedCount, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("StatusText"), "")
		Test.ExpectEqual(countShown(game, 1), 0, "the well was emptied")
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 600 })
end)

--!strict
-- A placement autopilot for the recording suites: it reads the match, scores every resting place of the falling
-- piece reachable from where it is now with a classic heuristic (lines, aggregate height, holes, bumpiness) and
-- returns the best rotation state and box column. Pure logic on script tables: it never touches the scene.
local Board = require("../../Scripts/Board")
local Match = require("../../Scripts/Match")

export type Plan = { State: number, Left: number, Score: number }

local Autopilot = {}

local function evaluate(board: Board.Board): number
	local aggregate, holes, bumpiness = 0, 0, 0
	local previous = -1
	for column = 1, board.Width do
		local height = 0
		for row = board.Height, 1, -1 do
			if board:Get(column, row) ~= "" then
				height = row
				break
			end
		end
		for row = 1, height - 1 do
			if board:Get(column, row) == "" then
				holes += 1
			end
		end
		aggregate += height
		if previous >= 0 then
			bumpiness += math.abs(height - previous)
		end
		previous = height
	end
	return -0.51 * aggregate - 0.36 * holes - 0.18 * bumpiness
end

-- The best place for the match's falling piece, or nil when it fits nowhere.
function Autopilot.Choose(match: Match.Match): Plan?
	local best: Plan? = nil
	local states = if match.Piece == "O" then 1 else 4
	local scratch = Board.New()
	local cells = match.Board.Cells
	for state = 0, states - 1 do
		for left = -3, 10 do
			if match.Board:Fits(match.Piece, state, left, match.Top) then
				table.move(cells, 1, #cells, 1, scratch.Cells)
				local top = match.Top
				while scratch:Fits(match.Piece, state, left, top - 1) do
					top -= 1
				end
				scratch:Place(match.Piece, state, left, top)
				local lines = scratch:ClearLines()
				local score = 0.76 * lines + evaluate(scratch)
				if best == nil or score > (best :: Plan).Score then
					best = { State = state, Left = left, Score = score }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

return Autopilot

-- Recording suite of LineClear.replay (Editor only): it plays the known pieces of the session seed like a player,
-- each placed where the autopilot scores best, steering with taps and a hard drop, until a line clears, and ends
-- with the cleared line on the HUD. It only reads the scene and injects input.
local Autopilot = require("../Lib/Autopilot")
local GameScript = require("../../Scripts/Game")

local function tap(action: string)
	Test.InjectAction(action, "Tap")
	Test.WaitTicks(2)
end

return Test.Suite("Record.LineClear", function()
	Test.Case("places the known pieces until a line clears", function()
		local found = Scene.FindByName("Game")
		Test.Expect(found ~= nil, "Main.scene has a Game entity")
		local game = (found :: Entity):GetScript() :: GameScript.Game
		Test.WaitTicks(10)
		local pieces = 0
		while game.Match.Lines == 0 and not game.Match.GameOver and pieces < 40 do
			local match = game.Match
			local locked = match.LockedCount
			local plan = Autopilot.Choose(match)
			if plan then
				local turns = 0
				while match.State ~= plan.State and turns < 4 do
					tap(if (plan.State - match.State) % 4 == 3 then "RotateCCW" else "RotateCW")
					turns += 1
				end
				local steps = 0
				while match.Left ~= plan.Left and steps < 12 do
					local before = match.Left
					tap(if plan.Left < match.Left then "MoveLeft" else "MoveRight")
					if match.Left == before then
						break
					end
					steps += 1
				end
			end
			tap("HardDrop")
			Test.Expect(match.LockedCount > locked, "the hard drop locked the piece")
			pieces += 1
			Test.WaitTicks(4)
		end
		Test.WaitTicks(30)
		Test.Expect(game.Match.Lines >= 1, "the placements cleared a line")
		Test.Expect(game.Match.Score >= 100, "and scored it")
		Test.Expect(not game.Match.GameOver, "the game is still running")
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 3000 })
end)

params.source:
--!strict
-- Pure-logic cases of the Tetris rules (no scene): SRS kicks, line clears and scores, the 7-bag, top-out,
-- hold, gravity, soft drop, lock delay, DAS/ARR, levels and restart.
local Bag = require("../Scripts/Bag")
local Match = require("../Scripts/Match")
local Pieces = require("../Scripts/Pieces")

type Controls = Match.Controls

local function newMatch(seed: number): Match.Match
	return Match.New(Random.New(seed))
end

-- Steps the match `ticks` times with the same controls.
local function stepTimes(match: Match.Match, controls: Controls, ticks: number)
	for _ = 1, ticks do
		match:Step(controls)
	end
end

local function hasEvent(match: Match.Match, event: string): boolean
	return table.find(match.Events, event) ~= nil
end

-- Fills `lines` bottom rows except column 10, drops a vertical I into the gap and returns the match.
local function clearWithI(lines: number, level: number): Match.Match
	local match = newMatch(5)
	match.Level = level
	match.Lines = (level - 1) * Match.LinesPerLevel
	for row = 1, lines do
		match.Board:SetRow(row, "XXXXXXXXX.")
	end
	match:SpawnPiece("I")
	match.State = 1
	match.Left = 8
	match.Top = 20
	Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("I", 1, 8, 20), "the vertical I fits above the gap")
	match:HardDrop()
	return match
end

return Test.Suite("Board", function()
	Test.Case("T kicks off the left wall", function()
		local match = newMatch(1)
		match:SpawnPiece("T")
		match.State, match.Left, match.Top = 1, 0, 10
		Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("T", 1, 0, 10), "T in state R touches the left wall")
		Test.Expect(not match.Board:Fits("T", 2, 0, 10), "the unkicked rotation overlaps the wall")
		Test.Expect(match:Rotate(1), "the rotation succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.State, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, 1, "kicked one column right")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, 10)
	end)

	Test.Case("T kicks off the right wall", function()
		local match = newMatch(1)
		match:SpawnPiece("T")
		match.State, match.Left, match.Top = 3, 9, 10
		Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("T", 3, 9, 10), "T in state L touches the right wall")
		Test.Expect(match:Rotate(1), "the rotation succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.State, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, 8, "kicked one column left")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, 10)
	end)

	Test.Case("I kicks off both walls", function()
		local left = newMatch(1)
		left:SpawnPiece("I")
		left.State, left.Left, left.Top = 1, -1, 10
		Test.Expect(left.Board:Fits("I", 1, -1, 10), "vertical I in column 1")
		Test.Expect(left:Rotate(-1), "R to 0 succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(left.State, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(left.Left, 1, "kicked two columns right")

		local right = newMatch(1)
		right:SpawnPiece("I")
		right.State, right.Left, right.Top = 3, 9, 10
		Test.Expect(right.Board:Fits("I", 3, 9, 10), "vertical I in column 10")
		Test.Expect(right:Rotate(1), "L to 0 succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(right.State, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(right.Left, 7, "kicked two columns left")
	end)

	Test.Case("T and I kick up off the floor", function()
		local t = newMatch(1)
		t:SpawnPiece("T")
		t.State, t.Left, t.Top = 0, 4, 2
		Test.ExpectEqual(t:DropDistance(), 0, "T rests on the floor")
		Test.Expect(t:Rotate(1), "0 to R succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(t.State, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(t.Left, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(t.Top, 3, "kicked one row up")

		local i = newMatch(1)
		i:SpawnPiece("I")
		i.State, i.Left, i.Top = 0, 4, 2
		Test.ExpectEqual(i:DropDistance(), 0, "I rests on the floor")
		Test.Expect(i:Rotate(1), "0 to R succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(i.Left, 5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(i.Top, 4, "kicked two rows up")
	end)

	Test.Case("a blocked rotation fails and leaves the piece", function()
		local match = newMatch(1)
		for row = 1, 22 do
			match.Board:SetRow(row, "XXX...XXXX")
		end
		match:SpawnPiece("I")
		match.State, match.Left, match.Top = 1, 2, 12
		Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("I", 1, 2, 12), "vertical I in the shaft")
		Test.Expect(not match:Rotate(1), "no kick fits in a three-wide shaft")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.State, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, 2)
	end)

	Test.Case("clears of 1 to 4 lines score 100, 300, 500 and 800 times the level", function()
		local expected = { 100, 300, 500, 800 }
		for lines = 1, 4 do
			local match = clearWithI(lines, 1)
			Test.ExpectEqual(match.Lines, lines, `{lines} lines cleared`)
			Test.ExpectEqual(match.Score, expected[lines], `score of {lines} lines`)
			Test.ExpectEqual(match.LastClear, lines)
			Test.Expect(hasEvent(match, `Clear{lines}`), "a clear event")
			Test.ExpectEqual(match.Board:Get(10, 1), if lines < 4 then "I" else "", "the rest of the I fell into the cleared rows")
			Test.ExpectEqual(match.Board:Get(1, 1), "", "the filled rows are gone")
		end
		local levelThree = clearWithI(4, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(levelThree.Score, 2400, "a tetris at level 3")
		local levelTwo = clearWithI(2, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(levelTwo.Score, 600, "a double at level 2")
	end)

	Test.Case("levels rise every 10 lines", function()
		local match = newMatch(5)
		match.Lines = 8
		match.Board:SetRow(1, "XXXXXXXXX.")
		match.Board:SetRow(2, "XXXXXXXXX.")
		match:SpawnPiece("I")
		match.State, match.Left, match.Top = 1, 8, 20
		match:HardDrop()
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Lines, 10)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Level, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Score, 300, "scored at the level before the rise")
		Test.Expect(hasEvent(match, "LevelUp"), "a level-up event")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match:GravityTicks(), 43, "gravity of level 2")
	end)

	Test.Case("the 7-bag yields each piece once per bag", function()
		local bag = Bag.New(Random.New(1234))
		for round = 1, 4 do
			local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
			for _ = 1, 7 do
				local name = bag:Draw()
				Test.Expect(not seen[name], `bag {round} repeats {name}`)
				seen[name] = true
			end
			for _, name in Pieces.Names do
				Test.Expect(seen[name] == true, `bag {round} lacks {name}`)
			end
		end
	end)

	Test.Case("the match deals its first seven pieces from one bag", function()
		local match = newMatch(77)
		local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		for _ = 1, 7 do
			Test.Expect(not seen[match.Piece], `{match.Piece} came twice`)
			seen[match.Piece] = true
			match:HardDrop()
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(#match.Queue, Match.PreviewCount)
	end)

	-- Lock out only: the O locks in rows 21 and 22 with a free spawn area below the stack, so neither a blocked
	-- spawn nor the seed's next piece can end the game; only Place's top-out result can.
	Test.Case("a lock above the visible rows tops out and ends the game", function()
		local match = newMatch(3)
		for row = 1, 20 do
			match.Board:SetRow(row, ".XXXXXXXXX")
		end
		Test.Expect(match:SpawnPiece("O"), "the O spawns")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, 22, "row 20 is full under the O, so it stays in rows 21 and 22")
		match.Left = 9
		Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("O", 0, 9, 22), "the O fits in columns 9 and 10")
		local queue = table.clone(match.Queue)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match:HardDrop(), 0, "the O cannot fall")
		Test.Expect(match.GameOver, "the lock out ended the game")
		Test.Expect(hasEvent(match, "GameOver"), "a game-over event")
		for _, cell in { { 9, 21 }, { 10, 21 }, { 9, 22 }, { 10, 22 } } do
			Test.ExpectEqual(match.Board:Get(cell[1], cell[2]), "O", `the O's block at column {cell[1]}, row {cell[2]}`)
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Piece, "O", "no next piece spawned")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, 9, "the locked O was not replaced by a spawn")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#match.Queue, #queue, "the queue keeps its length")
		for i, name in queue do
			Test.ExpectEqual(match.Queue[i], name, `next piece {i} was not taken`)
		end
		local locked = match.LockedCount
		local controls = Match.NewControls()
		controls.HardDrop = true
		match:Step(controls)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.LockedCount, locked, "nothing moves after game over")
		Test.Expect(not match:HoldPiece(), "no hold after game over")
	end)

	Test.Case("an I kicked above the well tops out when it locks", function()
		local match = newMatch(3)
		match.Board:SetRow(19, "...X.XX...")
		Test.Expect(match:SpawnPiece("I"), "the I spawns")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, 21, "the I dropped one row, into row 20")
		Test.Expect(match:Rotate(1), "the rotation succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.State, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, 5, "kicked one column right")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, 23, "and two rows up: the I's top block lies above the well")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match:HardDrop(), 0, "row 19 holds the I where it is")
		Test.Expect(match.GameOver, "the block above the well ended the game")
		Test.Expect(hasEvent(match, "GameOver"), "a game-over event")
	end)

	Test.Case("a blocked spawn tops out and ends the game", function()
		local match = newMatch(3)
		match.Board:SetRow(21, "...XXXX...")
		match.Board:SetRow(22, "...XXXX...")
		Test.Expect(not match:SpawnPiece("T"), "the spawn is blocked")
		Test.Expect(match.GameOver, "game over")
	end)

	Test.Case("hold swaps once per piece", function()
		local match = newMatch(21)
		local first = match.Piece
		local second = match.Queue[1]
		Test.Expect(match:HoldPiece(), "the first hold succeeds")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Hold, first)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Piece, second, "the next piece comes in when nothing was held")
		Test.Expect(not match:HoldPiece(), "a second hold of the same piece is refused")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Hold, first)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Piece, second)
		match:HardDrop()
		local third = match.Piece
		Test.Expect(match:HoldPiece(), "the next piece may hold again")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Piece, first, "the held piece comes back")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Hold, third)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.State, 0, "the swapped-in piece starts at its spawn state")
	end)

	Test.Case("gravity drops one row per level interval and soft drop is faster", function()
		local match = newMatch(9)
		local idle = Match.NewControls()
		local top = match.Top
		stepTimes(match, idle, 47)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, top, "no fall before 48 ticks at level 1")
		stepTimes(match, idle, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, top - 1, "one row after 48 ticks")

		local fast = newMatch(9)
		fast.Level = 10
		local fastTop = fast.Top
		stepTimes(fast, idle, 6)
		Test.ExpectEqual(fast.Top, fastTop - 1, "one row after 6 ticks at level 10")

		local soft = newMatch(9)
		local soften = Match.NewControls()
		soften.SoftDrop = true
		local softTop = soft.Top
		stepTimes(soft, soften, 10)
		Test.ExpectEqual(soft.Top, softTop - 5, "soft drop falls a row every 2 ticks")
	end)

	Test.Case("a grounded piece locks after the lock delay", function()
		local match = newMatch(9)
		match:SpawnPiece("O")
		match.Top = 2
		local idle = Match.NewControls()
		stepTimes(match, idle, Match.LockDelay - 1)

--!strict
-- Pure-logic cases of the Tetris rules (no scene): SRS kicks, line clears and scores, the 7-bag, top-out,
-- hold, gravity, soft drop, lock delay, DAS/ARR, levels and restart.
local Bag = require("../Scripts/Bag")
local Match = require("../Scripts/Match")
local Pieces = require("../Scripts/Pieces")

type Controls = Match.Controls

local function newMatch(seed: number): Match.Match
	return Match.New(Random.New(seed))
end

-- Steps the match `ticks` times with the same controls.
local function stepTimes(match: Match.Match, controls: Controls, ticks: number)
	for _ = 1, ticks do
		match:Step(controls)
	end
end

local function hasEvent(match: Match.Match, event: string): boolean
	return table.find(match.Events, event) ~= nil
end

-- Expects that the last lock ended the game by itself: the locked piece is still the match's piece and no next
-- piece left the queue (a spawn after the lock takes one, whether or not it then fits, so a game over that a
-- blocked spawn caused fails here).
local function expectNoSpawn(match: Match.Match, piece: string, left: number, queue: { string })
	Test.ExpectEqual(match.Piece, piece, "no next piece spawned")
	Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, left, "the locked piece was not replaced by a spawn")
	Test.ExpectEqual(#match.Queue, #queue, "the queue keeps its length")
	for i, name in queue do
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Queue[i], name, `next piece {i} was not taken`)
	end
end

-- Fills `lines` bottom rows except column 10, drops a vertical I into the gap and returns the match.
local function clearWithI(lines: number, level: number): Match.Match
	local match = newMatch(5)
	match.Level = level
	match.Lines = (level - 1) * Match.LinesPerLevel
	for row = 1, lines do
		match.Board:SetRow(row, "XXXXXXXXX.")
	end
	match:SpawnPiece("I")
	match.State = 1
	match.Left = 8
	match.Top = 20
	Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("I", 1, 8, 20), "the vertical I fits above the gap")
	match:HardDrop()
	return match
end

return Test.Suite("Board", function()
	Test.Case("T kicks off the left wall", function()
		local match = newMatch(1)
		match:SpawnPiece("T")
		match.State, match.Left, match.Top = 1, 0, 10
		Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("T", 1, 0, 10), "T in state R touches the left wall")
		Test.Expect(not match.Board:Fits("T", 2, 0, 10), "the unkicked rotation overlaps the wall")
		Test.Expect(match:Rotate(1), "the rotation succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.State, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, 1, "kicked one column right")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, 10)
	end)

	Test.Case("T kicks off the right wall", function()
		local match = newMatch(1)
		match:SpawnPiece("T")
		match.State, match.Left, match.Top = 3, 9, 10
		Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("T", 3, 9, 10), "T in state L touches the right wall")
		Test.Expect(match:Rotate(1), "the rotation succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.State, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, 8, "kicked one column left")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Top, 10)
	end)

	Test.Case("I kicks off both walls", function()
		local left = newMatch(1)
		left:SpawnPiece("I")
		left.State, left.Left, left.Top = 1, -1, 10
		Test.Expect(left.Board:Fits("I", 1, -1, 10), "vertical I in column 1")
		Test.Expect(left:Rotate(-1), "R to 0 succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(left.State, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(left.Left, 1, "kicked two columns right")

		local right = newMatch(1)
		right:SpawnPiece("I")
		right.State, right.Left, right.Top = 3, 9, 10
		Test.Expect(right.Board:Fits("I", 3, 9, 10), "vertical I in column 10")
		Test.Expect(right:Rotate(1), "L to 0 succeeds through a kick")
		Test.ExpectEqual(right.State, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(right.Left, 7, "kicked two columns left")
	end)

	Test.Case("T and I kick up off the floor", function()
		local t = newMatch(1)
		t:SpawnPiece("T")
		t.State, t.Left, t.Top = 0, 4, 2
		Test.ExpectEqual(t:DropDistance(), 0, "T rests on the floor")

	end)

			match.Board:SetRow(row, "XXX...XXXX")
		end

		Test.Expect(match.Board:Fits("I", 1, 2, 12), "vertical I in the shaft")
		Test.Expect(not match:Rotate(1), "no kick fits in a three-wide shaft")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.State, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Left, 2)
	end)

			Test.ExpectEqual(match.Board:Get(1, 1), "", "the filled rows are gone")
		end

		Test.ExpectEqual(match.Level, 2)

		Test.Expect(hasEvent(match, "LevelUp"), "a level-up event")
		Test.ExpectEqual(match:GravityTicks(), 43, "gravity of level 2")
	end)

				Test.Expect(not seen[name], `bag {round} repeats {name}`)
				seen[name] = true
			end
			for _, name in Pieces.Names do

		end

--!strict
-- The well: 10 columns by 22 rows, column 1 at the left and row 1 at the bottom. Rows 1 to 20 are visible;
-- rows 21 and 22 lie above the top, where pieces spawn. Pure logic: no engine calls.
local Pieces = require("./Pieces")

export type Board = {
	Width: number,
	Height: number,
	Visible: number,
	-- Cells[(row - 1) * Width + column]: "" when empty, else the name of the piece that left the block there.
	Cells: { string },
	Get: (self: Board, column: number, row: number) -> string,
	Fits: (self: Board, name: string, state: number, left: number, top: number) -> boolean,
	Place: (self: Board, name: string, state: number, left: number, top: number) -> boolean,
	ClearLines: (self: Board) -> number,
	SetRow: (self: Board, row: number, pattern: string) -> (),
	Clear: (self: Board) -> (),
	ToAscii: (self: Board) -> string,
}

local Width, Height, Visible = 10, 22, 20

local function get(self: Board, column: number, row: number): string
	return self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column]
end

-- Inside the well (above the top counts as inside, so a rotation may kick a piece there) and empty.
local function isFree(self: Board, column: number, row: number): boolean
	if column < 1 or column > self.Width or row < 1 then
		return false
	end
	if row > self.Height then
		return true
	end
	return self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column] == ""
end

-- Whether the piece in that rotation state fits with its box's left column and top row there.
local function fits(self: Board, name: string, state: number, left: number, top: number): boolean
	for _, block in Pieces.Get(name).States[state + 1] do
		if not isFree(self, left + block.X, top - block.Y) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Writes the piece's blocks inside the well and returns true when the lock tops out: when every block lies above
-- the visible rows (a lock out), or when any block lies above the well (row > Height, where a kick can lift a
-- piece), which the grid cannot hold.
local function place(self: Board, name: string, state: number, left: number, top: number): boolean
	local aboveVisible = true
	local aboveWell = false
	for _, block in Pieces.Get(name).States[state + 1] do
		local column, row = left + block.X, top - block.Y
		if row <= self.Visible then
			aboveVisible = false
		end
		if row > self.Height then
			aboveWell = true
		elseif row >= 1 and column >= 1 and column <= self.Width then
			self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column] = name
		end
	end
	return aboveVisible or aboveWell
end

-- Removes every full row, moving the rows above it down; returns how many rows it removed.
local function clearLines(self: Board): number
	local width = self.Width
	local cells = self.Cells
	local target = 1
	local cleared = 0
	for row = 1, self.Height do
		local full = true
		for column = 1, width do
			if cells[(row - 1) * width + column] == "" then
				full = false
				break
			end
		end
		if full then
			cleared += 1
		else
			if target ~= row then
				for column = 1, width do
					cells[(target - 1) * width + column] = cells[(row - 1) * width + column]
				end
			end
			target += 1
		end
	end
	for row = target, self.Height do
		for column = 1, width do
			cells[(row - 1) * width + column] = ""
		end
	end
	return cleared
end

-- Fills one row from a pattern of Width characters: "." leaves a cell empty, any other character is a block.
local function setRow(self: Board, row: number, pattern: string)
	for column = 1, self.Width do
		local character = string.sub(pattern, column, column)
		self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column] = if character == "." or character == "" then "" else character
	end
end

local function clear(self: Board)
	for i = 1, self.Width * self.Height do
		self.Cells[i] = ""
	end
end

-- The visible rows, top first, one line per row: "." for an empty cell, else the block's piece name.
local function toAscii(self: Board): string
	local lines: { string } = {}
	for row = self.Visible, 1, -1 do
		local characters: { string } = {}
		for column = 1, self.Width do
			local cell = self.Cells[(row - 1) * self.Width + column]
			characters[column] = if cell == "" then "." else cell
		end
		table.insert(lines, table.concat(characters))
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local Board = {}

function Board.New(): Board
	local board: Board = {
		Width = Width,
		Height = Height,
		Visible = Visible,
		Cells = table.create(Width * Height, ""),
		Get = get,
		Fits = fits,
		Place = place,
		ClearLines = clearLines,
		SetRow = setRow,
		Clear = clear,
		ToAscii = toAscii,
	}
	return board
end

return Board

--!strict
-- One game of Tetris as pure, tick-driven logic: spawning, SRS rotation, DAS/ARR shifting, gravity by level,
-- soft and hard drops, lock delay, hold, the next queue, line clears, scoring, levels and game over.
-- No engine calls: the Game behaviour feeds it Controls every tick and mirrors its state into the scene.
local Bag = require("./Bag")
local Board = require("./Board")
local Pieces = require("./Pieces")

-- The player's controls for one tick: held states and the presses of this tick.
export type Controls = {
	Left: boolean,
	Right: boolean,
	LeftPressed: boolean,
	RightPressed: boolean,
	SoftDrop: boolean,
	HardDrop: boolean,
	RotateCW: boolean,
	RotateCCW: boolean,
	Hold: boolean,
}

export type Match = {
	Board: Board.Board,
	Bag: Bag.Bag,
	-- The falling piece: its name, rotation state (0 to 3), box left column and box top row.
	Piece: string,
	State: number,
	Left: number,
	Top: number,
	Hold: string,
	HoldUsed: boolean,
	Queue: { string },
	Score: number,
	Lines: number,
	Level: number,
	GameOver: boolean,
	LockedCount: number,
	LastClear: number,
	LastClearPoints: number,
	GravityTimer: number,
	LockTimer: number,
	LockResets: number,
	LowestTop: number,
	ShiftDirection: number,
	ShiftTimer: number,
	-- What happened during the last Step, Reset or method call, in order (sounds and HUD read it).
	Events: { string },
	Step: (self: Match, controls: Controls) -> (),
	Move: (self: Match, columns: number) -> boolean,
	Rotate: (self: Match, direction: number) -> boolean,
	HardDrop: (self: Match) -> number,
	HoldPiece: (self: Match) -> boolean,
	SpawnPiece: (self: Match, name: string) -> boolean,
	DropDistance: (self: Match) -> number,
	GravityTicks: (self: Match) -> number,
	Reset: (self: Match) -> (),
}

local Match = {}

-- Ticks per row of gravity at 60 Hz, by level; levels past the end use the last entry.
Match.GravityByLevel = table.freeze({ 48, 43, 38, 33, 28, 23, 18, 13, 8, 6, 5, 5, 5, 4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1 })
-- Points per clear of 1, 2, 3 and 4 lines, multiplied by the level.
Match.LineScores = table.freeze({ 100, 300, 500, 800 })
Match.LinesPerLevel = 10
Match.SoftDropTicks = 2
Match.LockDelay = 30
Match.MaxLockResets = 15
Match.DasDelay = 10
Match.ArrTicks = 2
Match.PreviewCount = 3
Match.SpawnTop = 22

local function emit(self: Match, event: string)
	table.insert(self.Events, event)
end

local function fitsAt(self: Match, left: number, top: number): boolean
	return self.Board:Fits(self.Piece, self.State, left, top)
end

local function endGame(self: Match)
	if not self.GameOver then
		self.GameOver = true
		emit(self, "GameOver")
	end
end

-- After a successful move or rotation: a grounded piece gets its lock delay back, at most MaxLockResets times per row.
local function afterShift(self: Match)
	if not fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - 1) and self.LockResets < Match.MaxLockResets then
		self.LockTimer = 0
		self.LockResets += 1
	end
end

local function spawnPiece(self: Match, name: string): boolean
	local shape = Pieces.Get(name)
	self.Piece = name
	self.State = 0
	self.Left = shape.SpawnLeft
	self.Top = Match.SpawnTop
	self.GravityTimer = 0
	self.LockTimer = 0
	self.LockResets = 0
	if not fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top) then
		endGame(self)
		return false
	end
	-- Pieces spawn in rows 21 and 22 and drop one row at once when nothing blocks them.
	if fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - 1) then
		self.Top -= 1
	end
	self.LowestTop = self.Top
	return true
end

local function takeNext(self: Match): string
	local name = table.remove(self.Queue, 1) :: string
	table.insert(self.Queue, self.Bag:Draw())
	return name
end

local function spawnNext(self: Match)
	self.HoldUsed = false
	spawnPiece(self, takeNext(self))
end

local function lock(self: Match)
	-- Place reports a top-out: a lock out (every block above the visible rows) or a block above the well.
	local toppedOut = self.Board:Place(self.Piece, self.State, self.Left, self.Top)
	self.LockedCount += 1
	emit(self, "Lock")
	local cleared = self.Board:ClearLines()
	if cleared > 0 then
		local points = Match.LineScores[cleared] * self.Level
		self.Score += points
		self.Lines += cleared
		self.LastClear = cleared
		self.LastClearPoints = points
		emit(self, `Clear{cleared}`)
		local level = 1 + self.Lines // Match.LinesPerLevel
		if level > self.Level then
			self.Level = level
			emit(self, "LevelUp")
		end
	end
	if toppedOut then
		endGame(self)
		return
	end
	spawnNext(self)
end

local function move(self: Match, columns: number): boolean
	if self.GameOver or not fitsAt(self, self.Left + columns, self.Top) then
		return false
	end
	self.Left += columns
	emit(self, "Move")
	afterShift(self)
	return true
end

-- Rotates clockwise (1) or counter-clockwise (-1), trying each SRS kick in order.
local function rotate(self: Match, direction: number): boolean
	if self.GameOver or self.Piece == "O" then
		return false
	end
	local from = self.State
	local to = (from + direction) % 4
	for _, kick in Pieces.Kicks(self.Piece, from, to) do
		local left, top = self.Left + kick[1], self.Top + kick[2]
		if self.Board:Fits(self.Piece, to, left, top) then
			self.State = to
			self.Left = left
			self.Top = top
			emit(self, "Rotate")
			afterShift(self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function dropDistance(self: Match): number
	local distance = 0
	while fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - distance - 1) do
		distance += 1
	end
	return distance
end

-- Drops the piece to the floor and locks it there; returns the rows it fell.
local function hardDrop(self: Match): number
	if self.GameOver then
		return 0
	end
	local distance = dropDistance(self)
	self.Top -= distance
	emit(self, "HardDrop")
	lock(self)
	return distance
end

-- Swaps the falling piece with the held one (or the next one when nothing is held), once per piece.
local function holdPiece(self: Match): boolean
	if self.GameOver or self.HoldUsed then
		return false
	end
	local current = self.Piece
	local incoming = if self.Hold == "" then takeNext(self) else self.Hold
	self.Hold = current
	emit(self, "Hold")
	spawnPiece(self, incoming)
	self.HoldUsed = true
	return true
end

local function gravityTicks(self: Match): number
	local table_ = Match.GravityByLevel
	return table_[math.min(self.Level, #table_)]
end

local function shift(self: Match, controls: Controls)
	if controls.LeftPressed then
		self.ShiftDirection = -1
		self.ShiftTimer = 0
		move(self, -1)
		return
	elseif controls.RightPressed then
		self.ShiftDirection = 1
		self.ShiftTimer = 0
		move(self, 1)
		return
	end
	local held = (self.ShiftDirection == -1 and controls.Left) or (self.ShiftDirection == 1 and controls.Right)
	if not held then
		self.ShiftDirection = if controls.Left then -1 elseif controls.Right then 1 else 0
		self.ShiftTimer = 0
		return
	end
	self.ShiftTimer += 1
	if self.ShiftTimer >= Match.DasDelay and (self.ShiftTimer - Match.DasDelay) % Match.ArrTicks == 0 then
		move(self, self.ShiftDirection)
	end
end

local function step(self: Match, controls: Controls)
	table.clear(self.Events)
	if self.GameOver then
		return
	end
	if controls.Hold then
		holdPiece(self)
		if self.GameOver then
			return
		end
	end
	if controls.RotateCW then
		rotate(self, 1)
	end
	if controls.RotateCCW then
		rotate(self, -1)
	end
	shift(self, controls)
	if controls.HardDrop then
		hardDrop(self)
		return
	end

	local interval = gravityTicks(self)
	if controls.SoftDrop then
		interval = math.min(interval, Match.SoftDropTicks)
	end
	self.GravityTimer += 1
	if self.GravityTimer >= interval then
		self.GravityTimer = 0
		if fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - 1) then
			self.Top -= 1
			if self.Top < self.LowestTop then
				self.LowestTop = self.Top
				self.LockResets = 0
			end
			self.LockTimer = 0
		end
	end

	if fitsAt(self, self.Left, self.Top - 1) then
		self.LockTimer = 0
	else
		self.LockTimer += 1
		if self.LockTimer >= Match.LockDelay then
			lock(self)
		end
	end
end

-- Starts a fresh game on the same generator: an empty well, a new bag and the score, lines and level reset.
local function reset(self: Match)
	table.clear(self.Events)
	self.Board:Clear()
	self.Bag:Reset()
	table.clear(self.Queue)
	for _ = 1, Match.PreviewCount do
		table.insert(self.Queue, self.Bag:Draw())
	end
	self.Hold = ""
	self.Score = 0
	self.Lines = 0
	self.Level = 1
	self.GameOver = false
	self.LockedCount = 0
	self.LastClear = 0
	self.LastClearPoints = 0
	self.ShiftDirection = 0
	self.ShiftTimer = 0
	emit(self, "Restart")
	spawnNext(self)
end

function Match.New(generator: RandomGenerator): Match
	local match: Match = {
		Board = Board.New(),
		Bag = Bag.New(generator),
		Piece = "",
		State = 0,
		Left = 0,
		Top = 0,
		Hold = "",
		HoldUsed = false,
		Queue = {},
		Score = 0,
		Lines = 0,
		Level = 1,
		GameOver = false,
		LockedCount = 0,
		LastClear = 0,
		LastClearPoints = 0,
		GravityTimer = 0,
		LockTimer = 0,
		LockResets = 0,
		LowestTop = 0,
		ShiftDirection = 0,
		ShiftTimer = 0,
		Events = {},
		Step = step,
		Move = move,
		Rotate = rotate,
		HardDrop = hardDrop,
		HoldPiece = holdPiece,
		SpawnPiece = spawnPiece,
		DropDistance = dropDistance,
		GravityTicks = gravityTicks,
		Reset = reset,
	}
	reset(match)
	table.clear(match.Events)
	return match
end

-- Controls with nothing held or pressed, for callers that fill them in each tick.
function Match.NewControls(): Controls
	return {
		Left = false,
		Right = false,
		LeftPressed = false,
		RightPressed = false,
		SoftDrop = false,
		HardDrop = false,
		RotateCW = false,
		RotateCCW = false,
		Hold = false,
	}
end

return Match

--!strict
-- Integration cases in Main.scene, driven through the project's input actions with Test.InjectAction.
-- Each case starts from a fresh scene (Isolation "Case"); a few set up the board through the match first.
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")
local Pieces = require("../Scripts/Pieces")

local function getGame(): GameScript.Game
	local found = Scene.FindByName("Game")
	if found == nil then
		Test.Fail("Main.scene has no Game entity")
	end
	return (found :: Entity):GetScript() :: GameScript.Game
end

local function tap(action: string, waitTicks: number?)
	Test.InjectAction(action, "Tap")
	Test.WaitTicks(waitTicks or 2)
end

local function textOf(name: string): string
	local found = Scene.FindByName(name)
	local text = if found then found.Text else nil
	return if text then text.Text else "<missing>"
end

-- Counts the visible cells of the well that show a block of a piece (not the ghost).
local function countShown(game: GameScript.Game, row: number): number
	local count = 0
	for column = 1, 10 do
		local name = game.ShownName[(row - 1) * 10 + column]
		if name ~= "" and name ~= "Ghost" then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

-- Counts the cells of the whole well that show the ghost piece.
local function countGhosts(game: GameScript.Game): number
	local count = 0
	for _, name in game.ShownName do
		if name == "Ghost" then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

-- Expects every block of the ghost at the falling piece's columns in its landing row.
local function expectGhostBelowPiece(game: GameScript.Game)
	local match = game.Match
	local ghostTop = match.Top - match:DropDistance()
	for _, block in Pieces.Get(match.Piece).States[match.State + 1] do
		local column, row = match.Left + block.X, ghostTop - block.Y
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.ShownName[(row - 1) * 10 + column], "Ghost", `a ghost block at column {column}, row {row}`)
	end
end

return Test.Suite("Tetris", function()
	Test.Case("the scene pools the well, the previews and the HUD", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		Test.ExpectEqual(#game.Cells, 200, "one cell per visible square")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#game.Previews, 16, "four cells per preview slot")
		local active = 0
		for _, cell in game.Cells do
			if cell:IsActiveSelf() then
				active += 1
			end
		end
		Test.Expect(active >= 2 and active <= 8, `only the falling piece and its ghost show at the start (got {active})`)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ScoreText"), "SCORE\n0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LevelText"), "LEVEL\n1")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LinesText"), "LINES\n0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("StatusText"), "")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#game.Match.Queue, 3, "three next pieces")
		Test.Expect(game.Previews[5]:IsActiveSelf(), "the first next slot shows a piece")
		Test.Expect(not game.Previews[1]:IsActiveSelf(), "the hold slot starts empty")
	end)

	Test.Case("a hard drop locks the piece on the floor", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local piece = game.Match.Piece
		tap("HardDrop")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.LockedCount, 1, "one piece locked")
		Test.Expect(countShown(game, 1) >= 1, "blocks show in the bottom row")
		Test.Expect(game.Match.Piece ~= "", "the next piece spawned")
		local found = false
		for column = 1, 10 do
			if game.Match.Board:Get(column, 1) == piece then
				found = true
			end
		end
		Test.Expect(found, `the {piece} lies in row 1`)
	end)

	Test.Case("taps move one column and a held move auto-repeats to the wall", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local left = game.Match.Left
		tap("MoveLeft")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Left, left - 1, "a tap moves one column left")
		tap("MoveRight")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Left, left, "a tap moves one column right")
		Test.InjectAction("MoveRight", "Down")
		Test.WaitTicks(30)
		Test.InjectAction("MoveRight", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.Expect(not game.Match:Move(1), "DAS carried the piece to the right wall")
	end)

	Test.Case("rotate actions turn the piece both ways", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		if game.Match.Piece == "O" then
			tap("HardDrop")
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.State, 0)
		tap("RotateCW")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.State, 1, "clockwise")
		tap("RotateCW")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.State, 2, "clockwise again")
		tap("RotateCCW")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.State, 1, "counter-clockwise")
	end)

	Test.Case("hold stores the piece once per piece and shows it", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local first = game.Match.Piece
		local second = game.Match.Queue[1]
		tap("Hold")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Hold, first, "the piece went to the hold")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Piece, second, "the next piece came in")
		Test.Expect(game.Previews[1]:IsActiveSelf(), "the hold preview shows it")
		tap("Hold")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Piece, second, "a second hold of the same piece does nothing")
		tap("HardDrop")
		tap("Hold")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Piece, first, "the next piece swaps with the held one")
	end)

	Test.Case("soft drop falls faster than gravity", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local top = game.Match.Top
		Test.InjectAction("SoftDrop", "Down")
		Test.WaitTicks(12)
		Test.InjectAction("SoftDrop", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.Expect(game.Match.Top <= top - 5, `soft drop fell 5 rows or more (from {top} to {game.Match.Top})`)
	end)

	Test.Case("the ghost shows where the piece will land", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		Test.ExpectEqual(countGhosts(game), 4, "the well shows four ghost cells")
		expectGhostBelowPiece(game)
		local left = game.Match.Left
		tap("MoveLeft")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Left, left - 1, "the piece moved one column left")
		Test.ExpectEqual(countGhosts(game), 4, "still four ghost cells after the move")
		expectGhostBelowPiece(game)
	end)

	Test.Case("clearing a line scores and shows it on the HUD", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		game.Match.Board:SetRow(1, "XXXX..XXXX")
		game.Match:SpawnPiece("O")
		tap("HardDrop")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Lines, 1, "one line cleared")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Score, 100)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ScoreText"), "SCORE\n100")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LinesText"), "LINES\n1")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ClearText"), "SINGLE\n+100")
		Test.ExpectEqual(countShown(game, 1), 2, "the O's top half dropped into row 1")
		Test.WaitTicks(130)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ClearText"), "", "the clear banner fades")
	end)

	Test.Case("four lines with a vertical I score a tetris", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		for row = 1, 4 do
			game.Match.Board:SetRow(row, "XXXXXXXXX.")
		end
		game.Match:SpawnPiece("I")
		tap("RotateCW")
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			tap("MoveRight")
		end
		tap("HardDrop")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Lines, 4, "four lines cleared")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Score, 800)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("ClearText"), "TETRIS!\n+800")
		Test.ExpectEqual(countShown(game, 1), 0, "the well is empty again")
	end)

	Test.Case("ten lines raise the level", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		game.Match.Lines = 9
		game.Match.Board:SetRow(1, "XXXX..XXXX")
		game.Match:SpawnPiece("O")
		tap("HardDrop")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Level, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LevelText"), "LEVEL\n2")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("LinesText"), "LINES\n10")
	end)

	Test.Case("stacking hard drops tops out, then Restart starts a new game", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local game = getGame()
		local drops = 0
		while not game.Match.GameOver and drops < 40 do
			tap("HardDrop", 3)
			drops += 1
		end
		Test.Expect(game.Match.GameOver, `the stack topped out after {drops} drops`)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("StatusText"), "GAME OVER\nPress Enter to restart")
		local locked = game.Match.LockedCount
		tap("HardDrop")
		tap("MoveLeft")
		Test.WaitTicks(120)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.LockedCount, locked, "the game waits after game over")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#Test.GetScriptErrors(), 0, "no script error at top-out")
		tap("Restart")
		Test.Expect(not game.Match.GameOver, "a new game started")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.Score, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.Match.LockedCount, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf("StatusText"), "")
		Test.ExpectEqual(countShown(game, 1), 0, "the well was emptied")
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 600 })
end)
